titulo.en: Fewer cars or a better city?

intro.en: Read an editorial, separate its claims from its evidence, and follow a counterargument.

titulo.en: Track the argument, not just the topic

texto.en:
When reading an opinion article, identify the main claim, the reasons offered for it, and any objection the writer acknowledges. A connector can signal how ideas relate: **sin embargo** introduces a contrast; **por ejemplo** gives an illustration; **por tanto** marks a conclusion.

A claim is not automatically evidence. Look for a source, a concrete example or a comparison that supports it. Words such as **algunos**, **en general** and **puede** also limit a statement. They prevent a tendency from sounding like a universal rule.

The text below is a short editorial written for practice. Its recommendations represent the columnist’s view, not an official policy.

titulo.en: A centre for people, not for traffic

frases.es: Reducir el tráfico del centro no consiste en cerrar calles y esperar que el problema desaparezca.
frases.en: Reducing traffic in the centre does not mean closing streets and hoping that the problem disappears.

frases.es: Si queremos que más vecinos dejen el coche, primero debemos ofrecer autobuses frecuentes, aceras accesibles y rutas seguras para ir en bicicleta.
frases.en: If we want more residents to leave the car at home, we should first provide frequent buses, accessible pavements and safe cycle routes.

frases.es: Quienes trabajan de noche o viven lejos no siempre pueden elegir el transporte público; por eso, las normas necesitan excepciones claras.
frases.en: People who work at night or live far away cannot always choose public transport, so the rules need clear exceptions.

frases.es: Algunos comerciantes temen perder clientes, aunque las calles peatonales también pueden atraer a quienes prefieren comprar sin ruido ni humo.
frases.en: Some shopkeepers fear losing customers, although pedestrian streets can also attract people who prefer to shop without noise or fumes.

frases.es: No basta con afirmar que habrá menos contaminación: el ayuntamiento debería publicar datos antes y después de cada cambio.
frases.en: It is not enough to claim there will be less pollution: the council should publish data from before and after each change.

frases.es: Por más que una medida parezca urgente, será difícil mantenerla si no se explica a quién beneficia y cómo se corregirán sus efectos negativos.
frases.en: However urgent a measure may seem, it will be difficult to maintain unless it is explained who benefits and how its negative effects will be corrected.

frases.es: La meta no debería ser una ciudad sin coches, sino una ciudad en la que el coche no sea la única opción práctica.
frases.en: The goal should not be a city without cars, but a city in which the car is not the only practical option.

pregunta.en: What is the columnist mainly arguing for?

Offering practical alternatives before r.en: The writer argues for measures and alternatives together.

Removing every car from every street imm.en: The conclusion rejects a city with no cars as the goal.

Keeping current traffic rules unchanged.en: The text proposes changes and evaluation.

bloques.correcta: Offering practical alternatives before restricting traffic

pregunta.en: Which sentence gives a recommendation rather than verifiable evidence?

Some residents work at night.en: This can be checked as a fact about residents.

Some shopkeepers fear losing customers.en: This reports a concern attributed to a group.

bloques.correcta: The council should publish data before and after each change

pregunta.en: What does the writer concede about people who work at night or live far away?

They may not have a practical public-tra.en: The article uses this to support clear exceptions.

They oppose every traffic measure.en: The text does not claim this.

They always drive into the centre.en: The text does not say this.

bloques.correcta: They may not have a practical public-transport option

pregunta.en: Complete: no matter how urgent a measure seems…

bloques.frase: ___ una medida parezca urgente, habrá que evaluar sus efectos.

Por más que.en: This concessive expression is followed here by the subjunctive.

pregunta.en: Does the text present the proposed traffic policy as an official decision?

No, it is an editorial recommendation.en: The lesson identifies the text as a practice editorial.

bloques.correcta: No, it is an editorial recommendation
